issues.body: The final parenthetical still says this is "the same anonymous-class output-vocabulary gap as WebOnt-I5.5-005". That comparison remains unsupported: this case concerns reification/output of an in-profile anonymous hasSelf restriction, while the audited WebOnt case depends on owl:unionOf/list vocabulary outside EL. Both involve anonymous conclusion structure, but their blockers are materially different.
issues.fix_hint: Remove the final comparison, or explicitly contrast the cases: hasSelf is an in-profile anonymous-restriction reification/output gap; WebOnt-I5.5-005 is blocked because owl:unionOf and its list structure are outside EL and skipped.
issues.title: The hasSelf gap is still incorrectly equated with WebOnt-I5.5-005

verdict.summary: Round 2's documentation finding remains unchanged. The revised entry still calls this hasSelf case "the same anonymous-class output-vocabulary gap as WebOnt-I5.5-005", although the adjacent audit categorizes WebOnt-I5.5-005 by its owl:unionOf conclusion being outside EL. The present case instead reaches an in-profile anonymous hasSelf concept internally but cannot reify that concept back to the restriction bnode in output. Conflating those mechanisms makes the permanent-divergence audit inaccurate. Because the same minor finding remains at the same severity, progress is stagnant.
